skills.name: helm-release-management
skills.description: Inspect, upgrade, roll forward and uninstall Helm releases with the kagent-tools helm_* MCP tools. Use for questions about installed charts, release status, values, failed upgrades, or adding chart repositories.

skills.name: istio-traffic-debugging
skills.description: Debug Istio service-mesh traffic (503s, mTLS failures, routing not applied, sidecar or ambient/waypoint issues) using the kagent-tools istio_* MCP tools. Use when requests between mesh services fail or routing rules do not take effect.

skills.name: k8s-troubleshooting
skills.description: Diagnose unhealthy Kubernetes workloads (CrashLoopBackOff, Pending, ImagePullBackOff, OOMKilled, failing readiness, unreachable Services) using the kagent-tools k8s_* MCP tools. Use when a pod, deployment or service is not working as expected.
